FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Prairie Midstream Ltd.
REPORTED BY
Area supervisor
RECEIVED VIA
Text messages
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Got a leak at Sherwood Park station. Found it 08:49 this morning. Meter says 300 m³ out. Looks
like it's through the pipe body or a weld-don't know which yet. Whole thing stayed inside the
fence.
Carrying sweet gas, but the H2S monitor on my belt went off at the leak. Still not fixed yet.
Crew's on it but no resolution. Just wanted to get this out quick.
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
